I am 70 years old this year. I finished primary school and then went straight to the fields. I have farmed these 9 mu in Quzhou for 50 years. Seven mu I plant wheat in winter and maize in summer, back to back. The other 2 mu near my well I keep for cotton because that soil is a bit sandy and cotton likes it.

For the wheat, I already sowed it last October. I used the improved seed that Old Wang from the next village said was good — the dealer calls it something like "Liangxing" but I just know it grows strong. I put 30 jin of seed per mu, and before sowing I spread one bag of compound fertilizer per mu, the kind that says 18-22-5 on the bag, that is 50 kg per mu. Now it is spring, the wheat is waking up. I will irrigate three times: once now to green it up, once at jointing when the stems shoot up, and once when the grain is filling. At the first irrigation I will topdress 20 kg of urea per mu. I also spray three times: herbicide once early, then fungicide twice because if the yellow rust comes it will ruin everything. Last year I got about 1000 jin per mu. This year I want the same, around 500 kg per mu, if the spring wind does not dry it out.

For the summer maize, after I cut the wheat in June I have no time to plow. I hire the machine to drill the hybrid maize seed straight into the stubble — one package per mu, about 1.5 kg. At sowing I put 50 kg of compound fertilizer per mu, the 28-6-6 kind. When the maize grows to knee height, at the big trumpet stage, I topdress with 25 kg of urea per mu. Maize needs water at jointing and when the tassels come out, so I irrigate twice. I spray three times: herbicide before sowing, and insecticide twice because the armyworms always come in July. I expect about 1100 jin per mu, that is 550 kg per mu, same as last year.

For cotton on my 2 mu, I rotary-till in April and sow the improved cotton seed, about 2 jin per mu. I put 60 kg of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu as base dressing. When the cotton starts flowering I add 20 kg of urea per mu. I irrigate twice: once at flowering and once at the boll stage. But cotton's biggest problem is insects. I have to spray every 10 days or the bollworms will eat me out of house and home. Last year I sprayed 12 times, this year I will spray 12 times again. I hope to pick about 550 jin of seed cotton per mu, that is 275 kg per mu.

Fertilizer is expensive now. A 50 kg bag of compound costs about 140 yuan, and urea is about 100 yuan. But I dare not cut back. Two years ago my neighbor Liu tried to save 200 yuan on fertilizer and his wheat turned half yellow — he lost half a harvest. I would rather spend the money and sleep easy. My son works in a factory in Baoding and sends money home, so I can buy what I need. But I still watch what my neighbors do. If everyone on this side of the village is buying a new seed, I will try it on half a mu first. I am old but I know my land.
